scenarios.title: Buy 20% more leads
scenarios.what: Same win and activation rates, 20% more leads from the current mix.

scenarios.title: Raise activation to the paid-search rate
scenarios.what: Paid-search sellers already make a first sale 55% of the time. This sets activation for every signed seller to that rate.

scenarios.title: Coach reps below the team rate up to it
scenarios.what: Reps whose sellers activate below the team rate reach the team rate; everyone else stays the same.

findings.title: 57% of signed sellers never made a sale
findings.detail: 322 of 562 sellers signed from this lead cohort had no sale within 90 days. Raising activation to the paid-search rate (55%) adds 30% GMV; buying 20% more leads adds 20% and costs acquisition spend.
findings.action: Report activation rate next to deals closed for every rep, every week.

findings.title: Day 30 is the moment to step in
findings.detail: Activated sellers made their first sale after a median of 39 days. Of the 554 signed sellers with no sale by day 30, only 32% sold by day 90.
findings.action: Call every new seller with no sale by day 21, before the day-30 drop-off.

findings.title: Offline stores and manufacturers need a different onboarding track
findings.detail: Offline stores activated 24% of the time and manufacturers 32%, against 49% for resellers and 63% for large online sellers.
findings.action: Give offline and manufacturer sellers hands-on catalog setup in their first two weeks.

findings.title: Social leads close at half the average rate
findings.detail: Social leads won 5.9% of the time versus 12.0% overall, and returned R$14 of GMV per lead versus R$70 for paid search. 15% of leads have no tracked source.
findings.action: Tighten social lead qualification before adding budget, and fix source tracking on lead forms.

findings.title: One seller produced a quarter of new-seller GMV
findings.detail: The largest new seller sold 25% of the cohort's 90-day GMV and the top 10% sold 67%. The median activated seller sold R$319.
findings.action: Judge channels and reps on win and activation rates, not GMV per lead.

findings.title: Rep differences are within normal variation
findings.detail: Rep activation ranged from 29% to 59%, but no rep's 90% interval excludes the team rate.
findings.action: Coach the onboarding process for everyone; recheck reps when another quarter of deals closes.

findings.title: 183 still-active sellers flagged before they stopped selling
findings.detail: On June 30, 2018 the model flagged 183 of 915 sellers who had sold in the last 30 days. 25% of them made no sale in the next 60 days, versus 8% of the rest (2.2x). They sold R$157K in the 16 weeks before.
findings.action: Send the at-risk list to account managers every Monday, worst first.
